ko.executive_summary: Samsung selects Snapdragon for Galaxy S27 Pro and Ultra models, signaling continued reliance on Qualcomm flagship SoCs. Infineon secures power semiconductor partnerships with Vertiv for AI and automotive applications.
key_facts: Samsung Galaxy S27 Pro and Ultra adopt Snapdragon chipset
Infineon powers AI and automotive design wins through Vertiv partnership

implications.text: Snapdragon selection for Samsung's flagship line reinforces Qualcomm's dominance in premium mobile SoC market
Infineon's Vertiv partnership signals growing importance of specialized power delivery for AI infrastructure deployments

ko.counterpoint: Heterogeneous packaging strategies emerging as alternative approach to traditional monolithic SoC designs.
